name: bus_flood_dos
description: A node on the data bus floods both channels so navigation messages are not delivered
basis: assumption: one attempt per 2000 h; on-board monitoring notices loss of traffic in 15 min and isolating the node takes 1 h

name: gnss_spoofing
description: False GNSS signals make both navigation units compute a wrong position
basis: assumption: one episode per 5000 h; miss probability 0.1 as in CPS-02; a missed spoof is found in 30 min and re-validating navigation takes 2 h; RF-domain effect with no ATT&CK for ICS technique

name: false_nav_injection
description: False navigation messages are injected on the data bus from a compromised bus device
basis: assumption: one episode per 10000 h; plausibility checks reject half of the injections at onset; detection 1 h and re-validation 2 h

name: message_delay_replay
description: Navigation messages are held back or replayed so they arrive 80 ms late against a 50 ms deadline
basis: assumption: one episode per 3300 h; latency and deadline illustrative; T0830 is the closest technique (an adversary in the middle can block or modify traffic)
